item.text: The implementation now uses a 10 ms atomic eviction window and calls the TTL cache’s expired-item purge at the start of cache operations. `Values()` returns the values from the same active-item set that backs `Keys()`; I’m formatting and running the existing cache tests.

I found that the underlying cache’s `Keys()` returns stored keys without checking expiration. I’ve adjusted both enumeration methods to filter by each item’s expiration timestamp, so entries cannot leak through during the 10 ms scan-throttling window. I’m rerunning the package tests after that refinement.
